scenarios.title: Host suffix targets, Markdown destination decoding and asynchronous tab focus
steps: In a fresh disposable fixture Vault run create-resolution-regression-fixtures once; record the Source, Board and fixed target bytes

Run record-native-resolution-observation explicitly to save public cache tuples, source slices and official API results in the provider's own data.json. Preserve complete and incomplete observations separately from product verdicts; the command does not navigate or rebuild

Observe native navigation and Link Integrity target identities for the Markdown and Canvas destination inputs; compare incremental and rebuilt projections for the same stable source and native cache, recording host interpretation differences without creating missing targets

For Parent/Source.md create Parent/Subdir/Suffix Target.md, then add an Archive/Subdir/Suffix Target.md competitor; record the host resolver's actual best match after each create/delete/rename and source move, comparing both business projections to Rebuild

With the physical keyboard on desktop or emulator hardware-key input, focus Broken links and press one direction key, then rapid End/Home; observe selected tab, keyboard focus and visible panel after queries settle
During a delayed tab transition move focus to search, leave the window, hide or close the view; confirm completion does not reclaim focus
expected: Source supplementation and Canvas text decode Markdown destinations once before official host resolution. Wiki names and percent spellings retain their interpretation. Markdown tokens covered by native caches retain the native destination instead of substituting the source-decoded spelling; record actual per-token targets and diagnostics rather than requiring identical cross-platform totals
Suffix dependency changes revalidate the source and agree with the actual host resolver and a clean rebuild; a newly linked target is not high-confidence isolated
The latest completed tab selection and keyboard focus agree unless the user or lifecycle canceled the focus request

Preparation creates inert inputs once, refuses an existing root, does not force native cache readiness or modify product settings, and issues no product verdict. The explicit observer writes only its bounded provider receipt, preserves invalid or unstable facts as incomplete, and never treats a missing native tuple as a fabricated source interpretation

scenarios.title: Block ownership, nested labels, quote continuation and metadata-safe body hints
steps: Observe the untouched five-broken/four-isolated baseline in this disposable Vault
Run prepare-inline-atx-boundary; after native indexing inspect Broken links and Isolated files, then open the unique Missing source on L2
Run prepare-inline-nested-image; inspect both tabs after indexing settles
Run prepare-inline-reference-inner; inspect both tabs and verify the native reference-style Target link independently
Run prepare-inline-quote-continuation; inspect both tabs after indexing settles

Run prepare-inline-hint-metadata; turn body diagnostics On through Settings, inspect Reading and Live Preview hints and native navigation for both actual Missing occurrences, then restore the prior setting
Rebuild after each selected input and compare both projections to its incremental observation; record Source bytes, fixed targets, original fixture identities and actual native renderer limitations
expected: ATX boundary yields six broken/seven isolated: Missing remains on L2 and no Target edge crosses the heading boundary
Nested image yields five broken/four isolated: the outer Ghost image and inner Target link both connect, with no Missing diagnostic
Reference inner yields six broken/five isolated with a ready accurate native cache: Target connects through the inner reference, Ghost remains isolated and Missing is body text
Quote continuation yields five broken/five isolated: Target connects, Ghost is isolated and title Wiki text creates no diagnostics

Hint metadata yields seven broken/seven isolated: both actual Missing occurrences remain eligible for hints when native source/anchor and resolver proof succeeds; title text cannot start an HTML comment

The provider creates only the same three known notes and later changes Source among nine exact states; no mode forces cache readiness, creates Missing, changes user settings or issues a product verdict

steps: Observe the untouched five-broken/four-isolated baseline in this disposable Vault
Run prepare-inline-quoted; wait for native indexing, then inspect Broken links and Isolated files
Run prepare-inline-parenthesized; inspect both tabs after native indexing settles
Run prepare-inline-label-wiki; inspect both tabs and activate the unique Missing diagnostic source location
Run prepare-inline-invalid-outer; inspect both tabs and activate the unique Missing diagnostic source location

Rebuild after every selected input and compare both projections with the incremental observations; record Source bytes and verify Target, Ghost and the original fixture files did not change between modes
expected: Quoted link/image titles and parenthesized titles each produce five broken/five isolated files: Source connects to Target, Ghost is isolated and Missing has no diagnostic
Label Wiki produces six broken/four isolated files: Source connects to Target and Ghost, with exactly one Missing diagnostic on Source L1
Invalid outer syntax produces six broken/five isolated files: Source connects to Ghost, Target is isolated and Missing appears once on Source L1
Every rebuilt projection agrees with the corresponding incremental result, and actual diagnostic source navigation opens the known Source note
Preparation creates only Source, Target and Ghost once, then changes only Source between nine known byte states; Missing is never created and unknown files or edits are refused
Provider notices prepare input only; this scenario does not force a cold/partial metadata cache or issue an automated product verdict

scenarios.title: Container-relative code and reference-definition boundaries
steps: Observe the untouched five-broken/four-isolated baseline in this disposable Vault
Run prepare-block-quote-code, wait for indexing and inspect Broken links and Isolated files
Run prepare-block-list-prose, then prepare-block-definition-continuation; inspect both business tabs and the C5 Missing diagnostic after each transition
Run prepare-block-definition-non1-code, then prepare-block-definition-title; inspect both business tabs after each transition
Rebuild after each selected input and confirm its diagnostics and isolated files agree with the incremental results; verify only the known C5 Source fixture changed between modes
expected: Quote code has five broken and six isolated files; the new source and target have no connection
List prose and the definition continuation each have six broken and four isolated files: C5 Missing is reported once and C5 Source/C5 Target are connected

scenarios.title: Escaped delimiters, literal percent destinations and same-text source changes
steps: Observe the untouched five-broken/four-isolated baseline, then explicitly run create-context-regression-fixtures in this disposable Vault
Inspect Escaped.md: escaped-backtick prose links remain diagnostic while actual inline code and the shortened code span remain excluded
Enable body hints and inspect Percent.md in editing and reading views: missing literal/encoded percent files and the missing percent heading are marked, while the existing percent target is unmarked
Open A/Source.md and B/Source.md alternately in the same pane; their identical text resolves the explicit relative link only in A and marks it only in B
Switch B to A and back, rename the active source, and confirm hints belong to the current source; turn hints Off and confirm owned marks disappear
Rebuild and compare the selected source diagnostics with the incremental results; confirm source Markdown remains unchanged except the deliberate rename
expected: Escaped.md has exactly two broken diagnostics and no Protected code or Protected shorter code diagnostic
Percent.md has four confirmed broken diagnostics; native link navigation and the existing percent target remain intact
Same-text file changes, rename and Off do not retain marks from a previous source; A remains resolved and B remains missing
The clean rebuild agrees with incremental results; preparation alone is not product evidence

scenarios.title: Explicit reference accuracy and bounded rule preview
steps: Open Broken links and inspect all five diagnostics; confirm Ghost, Missing view target, and Not a link are absent
Navigate the Missing folded target and Missing canvas target sources from their diagnostics
Open Link Integrity settings, switch to Isolated files, and preview the Bounded regex expected-isolation rule
Close and reopen settings, confirm the rule remains enabled with the same pattern, then rebuild the index and inspect both business tabs
expected: The initial and rebuilt results contain five broken diagnostics and four default isolated files; excluded formula strings, dynamic prefixes, and fenced Canvas content yield no diagnostic
Bases opens without fabricated link coordinates; Canvas exposes the broken-text-node identifier and its actual text location
The ambiguous regex previews zero matches without freezing; its saved pattern survives reopening, and the preview and naming controls remain usable

scenarios.title: Continuous search and persistent folder expansion
steps: Open the results sidebar and type Missing continuously in search; select and replace part of the query, then clear it
Switch to Isolated files, show expected isolated files, and select the folder tree
Collapse Periodic, search for a nonmatching path, inspect the no-matching-results message, then use Clear search
Rebuild the index and verify that the folder remains collapsed
Switch Broken links to source-folder grouping, expand a source file, search for that source and clear search, then rebuild the index
expected: Search retains focus, the complete typed query, and its selection during result updates
Clear search restores input focus and the first page without changing filters; Periodic remains collapsed after filtering and an index rebuild
Both business tabs and result navigation remain usable
The source file remains expanded after matching search, clearing search and rebuilding the index

Search using Arabic text and open Connected/Source.md; follow both mixed-language links to العربية/Target-中文-123.md, checking the heading and block destination
